name: parasiter
description: Parasite SEO in your AI assistant for affiliates, creators, site owners and agencies: find and analyze platforms, pick content that sells, write reviews and brand content, video SEO and indexing, audit pages, create images, analyze niches and programs, plan paid placements, set goals and a daily plan, run clients or your own site, and keep a journal with checks for every page.

parasiter_key.title: PARASITER key (Free, Pro or Insider)
parasiter_key.description: Your personal key from the PARASITER email (starts with psr_). Free key by email, no card: parasiter.affiliatecredo.com/free.html. Leave empty to use only the content skills. Kept in Claude Code's own settings on your computer (not the system keychain, which Claude Code updates can clear), sent only to the PARASITER server.

dataforseo_token.title: DataForSEO API token (optional)
dataforseo_token.description: Your own DataForSEO account for position checks (pay per request, cost shown before every run). The token is your API login and API password (app.dataforseo.com → API Access, not the website password) joined by a colon and Base64-encoded. Make it on your own computer — Windows PowerShell: [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('LOGIN:PASSWORD')) · Mac/Linux terminal: printf 'LOGIN:PASSWORD' | base64 — and paste the result here. Stored in secure storage and sent only to DataForSEO's official MCP server — never to the PARASITER server or the chat. Leave empty if you don't use DataForSEO.

serpapi_key.title: SerpApi API key (optional)
serpapi_key.description: Your own SerpApi account, free plan 250 searches a month: position checks, platform scans and the search for new platforms (used before DataForSEO). serpapi.com → Your Account → API key. Kept in Claude Code's own settings on your computer and sent only to serpapi.com — never to the PARASITER server or the chat. Leave empty if you don't use SerpApi.
